summary: Full billing overhaul test — iteration 48 features. Tested all 16 specified test cases: subscription-status endpoint, transactions display_label, annual checkout, invalid billing_period 400, double-click guard, cancel-subscription end-of-period, trial/start flows, customer-portal 400, and fee-log filtering. All 28 backend tests pass (100%). All frontend billing flows verified via Playwright.

minor.issue: Some old transactions show display_label='Toolkit' (generic) because legacy transactions lack toolkit_kind in metadata. The transaction_label() function correctly falls back to 'Toolkit' when toolkit_kind is missing. Not a code bug — data issue with pre-existing transactions.

issues: Line 571 in BillingPage.jsx has overly complex ternary: `txn.display_label || txn.metadata?.plan === 'pro' ? ...`. Works correctly because display_label is always non-empty from backend, but confusing code. Should be simplified to `txn.display_label || 'Payment'`.

action_items: MINOR: Simplify txn-label ternary on BillingPage.jsx line 571 to avoid confusing operator precedence (code works correctly but is hard to read)
INFO: Some old transactions show generic 'Toolkit' label — only impacts legacy data, not new transactions
critical_code_review_comments: billing_service.py: expire_stale_subscriptions() — The $or clause for sub_cancels_at handles both None and {$exists:false} correctly. Idempotent design is solid.
billing_routes.py line 110: Double-click guard returns reuse:True with session_id but url:None — frontend BillingPage correctly handles this (checks data.url before redirect). Good defensive design.

billing_service.py: process_paid_session() idempotency check uses payment_status=='paid' on txn — correct. process_paid_session is called from both webhook AND checkout/status polling which means there's a race condition potential, but the $set operation on payment_status is effectively idempotent so no double-activation risk.
BillingPage.jsx line 571: Complex ternary with JS operator precedence — works correctly but should be simplified.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_trialui_* and TEST_trial_* fresh tradesperson accounts for testing trial start flow. trial_ends_at is now set on these accounts. Also temporarily upgraded pro@test.com to Pro plan for sub-status-strip testing, then reset back to Standard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All billing overhaul features fully verified and passing. pro@test.com is back on Standard plan (reset after Pro plan UI test). Fresh test accounts TEST_trial_* and TEST_trialui_* were created and have trial_ends_at set. The double-click guard test creates pending subscription sessions for pro@test.com — these may affect future checkout tests if they run within 60s of the pending session. The annual price is confirmed: NET=€299.90, brutto=€359.88 (20% VAT). Stripe webhook is wired to process_paid_session(). Background expiry scheduler starts 30s after boot, runs every 6h.
rca_of_issues: No critical bugs found. All 16 specified test cases pass. Minor: generic 'Toolkit' display_label for old transactions is expected fallback behavior in transaction_label() when toolkit_kind not in metadata.
